name: io.github.77777R7/octocrawl
title: Octocrawl
description: Web pages as clean Markdown and JSON for AI agents, in fewer tokens, with an Evidence Record.

environmentVariables.name: W2L_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Octocrawl API the server calls: npx octocrawl serve on this computer (default http://127.0.0.1:8787), or https://api.octocrawl.dev

environmentVariables.name: W2L_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A bearer token for a hosted or self-hosted API; none for a local one

environmentVariables.name: W2L_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: The tool groups to list, comma-separated: core, crawl, batch, products, logins, monitor, delivery, or all (default all); the same as --toolsets

environmentVariables.name: W2L_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: 1 lists read-only tools alone, with a scrape that does not act as the person; the same as --read-only
